decisions.decision: Consolidated all Phase-A + wire-format tests into backend/tests/test_round70_gateway.py instead of separate auth/routes/anthropic files
decisions.rationale: Context-efficient; same coverage, shares make_db/make_client helpers

decisions.decision: Fixed budget_enforcement admin-query join (User.custom_role / CustomRole.permissions don't exist on model) by switching to User.role.in_(['admin','owner','billing_admin']) with tenant fallback
decisions.rationale: The broken join raised AttributeError before the notification call, so no enforcement notification ever delivered

decisions.decision: map_gateway_error implemented as standalone module function in gateway/__init__.py (not an instance method)
decisions.rationale: Usable by both route modules and unit tests without constructing a GatewayService

decisions.decision: Rate limiting is in-memory per-key sliding window (module-global _rate_limit_state)
decisions.rationale: Matches the repo's personal-edition zero-dependency posture; tests must clear _rate_limit_state

decisions.decision: Phase D: subscription intent encoded in OAuth state (llm:{provider}:{credential_type}:{user_id}) so callback persists credential_type without server-side state
decisions.rationale: State is CSRF-bound to the authenticated user (403 mismatch); no extra session storage

decisions.decision: Phase D: LLMCredentialService + connect flow share BYOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY for Fernet token encryption; legacy NULL credential_type treated as oauth
decisions.rationale: Consistent encryption both directions; backwards compatible with pre-column rows
